chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from Ahmad ibn al-Nasr, he said: Abu Jamila al-Mufaddal ibn Salih narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Turayf from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:

Indeed, the Jews came to a woman from among them named Abda and said: O Abda! As you know, Muhammad has destroyed the pillar of the Children of Israel and destroyed Judaism. The elites of the Children of Israel have paid dearly for this poison for him, and they will give you a reward if you poison him with this sheep. So Abda roasted the sheep and gathered the leaders in her house. She came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) and said: O Muhammad! You know what is obligatory for me [as your neighbor]. The leaders of the Jews are present with me, so honor me with your companions.

So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) went with Ali (peace be upon him), Abu Dujana, Abu Ayyub, Sahl ibn Hunayf, and a group of Muhajirin. When they entered and the sheep was brought out, the Jews covered their noses with wool, stood on their feet and leaned on their staffs. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to them: Sit down. They said: When a prophet visits us, none of us sit down, and we would hate for our breath to reach him with anything harmful. The Jews lied - may the curse of God be upon them. They only did that out of fear of the fumes of the poison and its smoke.

When the sheep was placed before him, its shoulder spoke and said: Stop, O Muhammad! Do not eat me, for I am poisoned. So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) called for Abda and said to her: What caused you to do this? She said: I said to myself: If he is a prophet, it would not harm him; and if he is a liar or a sorcerer, I would have relieved my people from him.

So Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended and said: The Peace sends you greetings and says: Say: In the name of Allah, by which every believer calls, and by which every believer reaches glory. By His light which illuminated the heavens and the earth. By His power before which every arrogant tyrant submitted and every rebellious devil was vanquished - from the evil of poison, sorcery, and evil touches. In the name of the Most High, the King, the One, besides whom there is no god. 'And We send down of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy for the believers, and it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.' [17:82]
So the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said that, and he ordered his companions, and they said it too. Then he said: Eat. Then he ordered them to perform cupping.

key_terms.سورة السم: The rising fumes of the poison

ai.seo_question: What is the story of the poisoned sheep and the protective supplication revealed to Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) narrates the incident of the poisoned sheep, where Jewish leaders conspired to poison the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) through a woman named Abda. When the sheep was placed before the Prophet, its shoulder miraculously spoke to warn him. Upon confrontation, Abda confessed her reasoning. Gabriel then descended with a powerful protective supplication that includes Quran 17:82, which the Prophet and his companions recited before eating safely. The incident took place in Medina during the Prophet's interactions with the Jewish community, demonstrating divine protection of the Prophet.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdullah al-Barqi from Ahmad b. al-Nasr. He said: Abu Jamila al-Mufaddal b. Salih narrated to me from Sa`d b. Turayf from al-Asbagh b. Nubata from `Ali (as).  He said:

The Jews came to a woman from among them named `Abda. They said to her: O `Abda! As you know, Muhammad has destroyed the pillar of the Children of Israel and destroyed Judaism. The elites of the Children of Israel have prepared this poison for him, and they have come to you to have you poison him with this sheep. So, `Abda roasted the sheep and gathered the leaders in her house. She came to the Messenger of Allah (s) and said: O Muhammad! I have done what is obligatory for me [as your neighbour]. I have the leaders of the Jews present, so distinguish me with your companions.

So, the Messenger of Allah (s) went with `Ali (as), Abu Dujana, Abu Ayyub, Sahl b. Hanif, and a group of Muhajirin. When they entered and the sheep was brought out, the Jews covered their noses with wool, stood on their feet and leaned on their staffs. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said to them: Sit down. So, they said: When a prophet visits us, none of us are to sit down. We would hate to have the harm of our breath reach you.  The Jews had lied – may Allah curse them. Rather, they only did that out of fear of the poison and its steam.

When the sheep was placed in front of him, its shoulder spoke, saying: Stop, Muhammad. Do not eat me, for I am poisoned. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) called for `Abda and said to her: What caused you do to this! So, she said: I said [to myself]: “If he were a prophet, then it would not harm him. If he were a liar or a sorcerer, then my people will be relieved from him.”

So, Gabriel (as) came down and said: The Peace recites the salaam to you and says: “Say: In the name of Allah, by which every believer calls, and by which every believer reaches glory. By His light, which illuminates the heavens and the Earth. By His power, which subjugates every arrogant tyrant and relinquishes every rebellious devil from the evil of poison, sorcery, and deceit. In the name of the High, the King, the Alone, besides whom there is no other god, ‘We have sent down of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy to the believers, and it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.’ [17:82]”
So, the Prophet (s) said that, and he ordered his companions [to say that as well]; so they said that. Then, he said: Eat. Then, he ordered them to stop.
